name: Abreu e Lima (Brazil)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green with narrow green stripes within the white, charged at the centre with the municipal emblem: a yellow cogwheel with a blue disc reading AMOR between green branches, under the date 14 DE MAIO DE 1982 and over a scroll reading ABREU E LIMA.
history: Abreu e Lima is a municipality in the state of Pernambuco, Brazil.

features.role: cogwheel with a blue disc reading AMOR, between branches
date 14 DE MAIO DE 1982 and scroll ABREU E LIMA
